input_interpretation.facts: A string here denotes the original reason(facts=...) text input. It is not RDF.
input_interpretation.rules: Each ordinary object in an array denotes construction of ForwardRuleDTO(**fields) before calling reason; a string denotes the original string rule. This is a proposed JSON transport adapter, not evidence that the original runtime accepts mappings. Explicit __original_python_type__ overrides this notation only in the negative dict case.
input_interpretation.missing_dto_fields: confidence defaults 1.0, priority defaults 0; rule_id and text are required.
input_interpretation.nonfinite_numbers: No NaN/Infinity token is serialized into this JSON; rejection is documented in AUDIT, not pretended as standard JSON input.

comparison.success: Compare complete normalized result fields and inference sequence; confidence numeric value and original 1.0 output type, not an inferred truth guarantee. conclusions is separately evaluated property.
comparison.failure: Compare class/stage/message where identified; no claim of new Rust error-code identity or exact interpreter error wording for missing constructor arguments.
comparison.execution: No original Python module was imported/executed; no Cargo or Rust program was run to generate these expected values. Cases were manually traced from frozen source.
